_doc: Narration of the recorded demo. `text` is the subtitle and the phone caption; `say` (optional) is what the voice reads when it should differ (numbers, symbols). `who` and `shows` feed the README timeline (timeline.py). session.js refers to lines by `id` and waits for each line to finish before the next.

lines.text: PPRD East table-top exercise, with AI support. One phone plays every role: the Director, the Mayor, the Fire Commander and Regional Civil Protection.
lines.say: P P R D East table-top exercise, with A I support. One phone plays every role: the Director, the Mayor, the Fire Commander and Regional Civil Protection.
lines.shows: One device can run the whole exercise

lines.text: Each player picks a language. Regional Civil Protection will play in Armenian.
lines.shows: Language is per player and can change at any time

lines.text: The Director starts the exercise. Day 1, 13:00: a wildfire is burning on Pine Hill.
lines.say: The Director starts the exercise. Day one, one p.m.: a wildfire is burning on Pine Hill.
lines.shows: Turn-based control; turn speed set to 120×

lines.text: The Director sends the first injects from the exercise script. The AI translates each one for its recipient.
lines.shows: MSEL continuity with PPRD East 3; injects translated per recipient

lines.text: The Mayor receives the injects in Italian: the fire, and 120 pupils at Pineta Primary School.
lines.shows: Role-specific information in the player's language

lines.text: The Mayor answers in Italian, in their own words.
The Fire Commander orders fire lines using zone codes from the map grid, and an air-tanker drop.
The AI turns each reply into commands, and the simulator checks every command against the role's authority and resources.
lines.say: The A I turns each reply into commands, and the simulator checks every command against the role's authority and resources.

lines.text: It flags a real constraint: evacuating 120 pupils needs 3 buses, but the Mayor has only 2.
lines.shows: Deterministic resource checks the AI cannot bypass

lines.text: The Director writes an AI prompt: one extra bus for the Mayor, confirmed by an inject.
lines.say: The Director writes an A I prompt: one extra bus for the Mayor, confirmed by an inject.

lines.text: The Director reviews the AI's proposal, a resource change plus an inject draft, and approves it.
lines.say: The Director reviews the A I's proposal, a resource change plus an inject draft, and approves it.
lines.shows: AI proposes, Master approves; nothing is applied silently

lines.text: The Fire Commander's orders are approved, with a note to the player.
And the Mayor's orders now pass: 3 buses for 120 pupils.
The Mayor gets exercise control's feedback in Italian.
The Director resolves turn 1: thirty simulated minutes, played live on the big screen at 120 times speed.
lines.shows: Approved actions apply at resolution; live simulation

lines.text: Flame length follows the fire's intensity and the share of Monte Carlo runs that burn each cell. The glow ahead is where only some runs reach.
lines.shows: Intensity and probability drive the flames

lines.text: The fire lines are cut, the air tanker drops, and the school is evacuated to the sports centre.
Every player gets an AI-written situation update for their role.
lines.say: Every player gets an A I written situation update for their role.
lines.shows: Per-role situation reports in each player's language

lines.text: Turn 2. The Director escalates: a wind warning, then commands by code, raising the wind to 55 km/h and starting a new fire in zone G5.
lines.say: Turn two. The Director escalates: a wind warning, then commands by code, raising the wind to fifty-five kilometres per hour and starting a new fire in zone G 5.

lines.text: Regional Civil Protection reads the wind warning in Armenian, and asks for international assistance through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism.
A vague order from the Fire Commander…
…gets a clarification question from the AI instead of a guess.
lines.say: gets a clarification question from the A I, instead of a guess.

lines.text: The Fire Commander answers precisely.
The Director rejects the vague order, and approves the assistance request and the precise fire lines.
Turn 2 resolves live: sixty minutes. Reinforcements arrive, the lines protect Pineta, and the new fire spreads through the farmland.
Every inject, reply, AI interpretation, decision and consequence is logged for the debrief. Humans decide; the AI mediates.
lines.say: Every inject, reply, A I interpretation, decision and consequence is logged for the debrief. Humans decide; the A I mediates.
